notes: Two things this release. First, redirects now keep themselves honest against your sitemap. A destination Transmission derived follows the page's sitemap node when the tree moves, and is cleared when the page stops moving — previously a redirect on a Keep or Evolve page was never revisited once it existed, so reorganizing the tree (or building a sitemap and deleting it) left old destinations behind to contradict the new one. Anything you typed or picked yourself is never touched. For files that already carry stale destinations, the new Migration → Redirect Health Check finds them — pages redirecting to themselves, pages carrying a redirect while not on the sitemap at all, destinations that disagree with the page's node — shows you every one, and repairs the groups you tick in a single undoable step. Second, a collapsed section in the Visual Sitemap now tells you how much it's hiding: a folded card reads "6 pages hidden" instead of reporting its own page count, and a new Counts dropdown chooses what that line reports. Create Sitemap from Audit also now asks what the tree is for, and offers to make you a copy if you're building a current-state snapshot to show a client.
